plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp boxing plan with endurance as the main priority, supported by enough power and strength work to keep you athletic. Week 1 establishes a baseline back squat training max for future tracking, then Weeks 2-4 build repeatable aerobic and threshold fitness with brief explosive work and simple full-body strength. The parent 12-week cycle starts broad here, then progresses endurance quality and finally sharpens output without forcing a fight-camp speed peak.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build aerobic capacity and work capacity first while keeping simple power and strength work in place.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress threshold and repeat-effort conditioning while maintaining core full-body strength and power.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep endurance specific and efficient while expressing faster, sharper boxing-supportive power.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump fast and land quietly. Reset between reps and stop if height drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a box height that lets you land softly without tucking hard.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Start from a still quarter squat and drive straight up.

exercises.name: 2. Back Squat
exercises.notes: Use smooth warm-up sets, then build to one hard set with clean form. This sets your baseline for later loading.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log the heaviest clean top set of 3-5 reps.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Stop before form breaks and log the load and reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if back squat setup is uncomfortable and you can keep a stable rack position.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat

substitutionOptions.notes: Brace hard and avoid twisting.
